_help: Act 4, day 1: Professor Friedrich Adler at the German camp. Standing with him is the stat [adler, trust]. A hint about one of the sites his expedition claimed sets hint_<site> only (no clue).

first.speaker: adler
first.line: Professor Friedrich Adler, of Berlin. You must be the gentleman who raced us across the desert. I hope you will be as careful here as you were quick getting here.

again.speaker: adler
again.line: Good day. Please mind the trench; Wilhelm has only just finished drawing it.

choices.label: Offer to compare notes
choices.line: We're all reading the same walls, Professor. Why not compare what we find?

choices.label: Ask about Krüger
choices.line: Your young man with the notebook never seems to stop writing.

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: I'll let you get back to work.

pleased.speaker: adler
pleased.line: A sensible proposal. Evidence shared is evidence tested. Very well, one observation of ours...

hint_horus.speaker: adler
hint_horus.line: The throne beneath the Horus statue was carved for two rulers. One of the names has been removed with a violence I have rarely seen in stone.

hint_hieroglyphs.speaker: adler
hint_hieroglyphs.line: The long wall of inscriptions has been plastered over and carved again. Where the plaster has fallen, there is an older text beneath.

hint_obelisk.speaker: adler
hint_obelisk.line: The broken obelisk counts a king's years and then simply stops counting. No death is recorded. I find that more troubling than any curse.

hint_astronomer.speaker: adler
hint_astronomer.line: The markings on the platform follow a single star. If Wilhelm's arithmetic is right, it returns this very season.

hint_none.speaker: adler
hint_none.line: But we have not yet finished our recording. I will not speak before the evidence is complete.

stung.speaker: adler
stung.line: This is not a vault, sir. Every object you pull from the sand without recording it is a sentence torn out of history. Please remember that.

kruger.speaker: adler
kruger.line: Wilhelm Krüger, my epigrapher. Gifted, and impatient. He believes every inscription is speaking to him personally.
